operations.summary: Replace a password with a delivered recovery link
operations.description: recovery_context is an opaque server-signed value bound to the token, tenant, scope, challenge, and expiry. The server verifies it before invoking the password reset CAS. Tampered, cross-token, expired, revoked, consumed, and unknown links fail closed. Authorization and API-key headers are ignored.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Stable key for this operation and payload. Reusing a key with different input returns account_recovery_idempotency_conflict.

fields.name: recovery_context
fields.description: Opaque signed v1 recovery context. Clients must not parse or generate it.

fields.name: new_password
fields.description: New password; 8 to 1024 printable ASCII characters (no space) with at least two of upper case, lower case, digits and symbols; otherwise password_policy_unmet.

fields.name: confirm_password
fields.description: Must exactly match new_password and is subject to the same password policy.

responses.description: Password replaced and all refresh sessions revoked, or an exact idempotent replay.

operations.description: Always returns the same 202 representation for an existing active account, an unknown username, a disabled account, or a suspended membership. No response field reports account existence, identity, challenge, token, expiry, channel, or delivery state. Authorization and API-key headers are ignored. JSON is limited to the configured 8 KiB default; duplicate or unknown fields, media type parameters, and trailing values are rejected.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Username only. The handler trims surrounding whitespace and enforces 1 to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Email and phone lookup are not part of this contract.
